conclusions.stateEncoding: Complete gzip-v1 rows; not cross-state structural object sharing.
conclusions.priority: Benchmark a self-contained, owner-checked and checksummed identity row codec before widening cross-entity references.
conclusions.notAdditive: Compression savings, lastControl reference savings, action dictionaries and nested snapshots overlap; do not sum these alternatives.
conclusions.performance: No read/write timing, WAL write amplification or VACUUM reclamation was measured. Byte-size experiments are not performance gains.
preservation: Keep identity IDs, unknown/hypothesis status, occurrence ordering, context and original evidence intact; do not delete not_observed rows.
Preserve action IDs, observation/state ownership, preconditions, basis, risk, sample values and per-capture candidate history; byte interning is not semantic coverage.
Keep event sequence/type/time/session and historical payloads. Never replace a historical event with a reference to a mutable entity.
If identity references shared Observation objects later, add identity roots to mark/sweep and session deletion/retention validation, pin exact objects and verify before atomic collection.

Do not reconstruct all historical Observations per identity read. Benchmark cold and warm all-identity reads, normal capture/put cost, incremental occurrence append and memory under current real fixtures.
